notes.title: NEW CLOUD LEVEL
notes.content:
We know you've waited a long time for that update and here it finally is. Next to the very needed bug fixes we also added a second cloud level. It's called The Dreamfields and has the same main mechanic as the Cloud City, but with an extra twist: It has a portal that allows you to fall trough the clouds.

New:
[list]
[*] Added new Level: Dreamfields
[*] Added more online regions and added option to manually select a region
[/list]

Improvements:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the game to crash or endlessly load at start
[*] Fixed a bug in 2 vs 2 tournament mode that sometimes resulted in a point going to the wrong team
[*] Fixed modifier enable setting not being saved
[*] Multiple fixes in community event
[*] Improved online level selection, especially in high ping situations
[/list]

May the bullettime be with you!
Best,
Team Maniax

notes.title: Lunar New Year Event 2020
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

To celebrate Chinese new year we made some [b]amazing skins for you[/b]! Don't lose any time, grab your friends and get into some bullet time action. Because the skins will be [b]only active during the Lunar event[/b] which will end at February 6.

Additionally we added a [b]leveling system[/b] where you earn points by playing. You can compare your level with other Retimed players around the world in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/760810/leaderboards/4058818/]global Leaderboard.[/url]

In the future we will also add rewards for achieving certain levels.

Here is the complete list of changes:

[b]New[/b]
- 4 Lunar skins
- Lunar themed start screen
- Level system 
- Warning when player try to play together that have different versions of the game
- Kill cap get adjusted for remaining players when a player leaves an online match
- Tutorial screen now also includes how to Quick Chat



[b]Fixes[/b]
- Falling Icicle collider fixed
- Single Icicle blocks an ammunition crate on both sides


May the bullet time be with you!
Best,
Team Maniax

notes.title: Patchnotes version 1.14.2 and 1.14.3
notes.content:
In this Update we added Christmas skins for our Characters and fixed some bugs related to getting achievements.

Here is the complete list of changes:

[b]New[/b][list][*]Added Christmas skins for our Characters. Those will be present in every game mode except for quick play. Quick play will follow in a few days.
[*]Added a ForceMouseCursorVisible launch option that, when set to true will always show the mouse cursor.
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b][list][*]Fixed a bug in the "One shot one kill" achievement that accidentally counted missed shots of the enemies as a fail
[*]Fixed "Happytown expert" and "Happytown master" achievements not getting properly triggered. Those will get retroactively applied.
[*]Fixed online tournament matches not getting counted towards the "Virtuoso" achievement.
[/list]

Added a ForceMouseCursorVisible launch option that, when set to true will always show the mouse cursor.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug in the "One shot one kill" achievement that accidentally counted missed shots of the enemies as a fail
Fixed "Happytown expert" and "Happytown master" achievements not getting properly triggered. Those will get retroactively applied.
Fixed online tournament matches not getting counted towards the "Virtuoso" achievement.

notes.title: Patchnotes version 1.14.1
notes.content:
In this Patch we fixed a bug that caused the "pick and ban" phase in the team tournament to not work properly. Additionally we made some small improvement and fixes.

Here is the complete list of changes:

[b]New[/b][list][*]Added a "Texture Quality" launch option to set the textures to a lower resolution in order to circumvent an issue on some graphics card that can't handle large textures. In order to activate this feature go into the properties of the game, click on the Set Launch Options... button and enter "TextureQuality=X" where X is a number that tells how many times the resolution of one texture is halved. So 0 = default, 1 = half, 2 = quarter etc.
[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b][list][*]Replaced the operating system specific mouse cursor with a larger Retimed specific cursor
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b][list][*]Fixed pick and ban not working correctly for team tournament
[*]Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the in game cross hair to be black.
[*]Fixed player names with non Latin characters not being properly displayed in the game end screen
[*]Fixed mouse cursor being displayed during game
[/list]

In order to activate this feature go into the properties of the game, click on the Set Launch Options... button and enter "TextureQuality=X" where X is a number that tells how many times the resolution of one texture is halved. So 0 = default, 1 = half, 2 = quarter etc.

notes.title: Patchnotes version 0.7.3
notes.content:
[b]New[/b]
[list]
[*]Settings menu added
[*]Tournament mode added: This mode limits the number of players to two, allows you to choose the same character twice and only shows the maps that are in the official SMGL map pool, in the future this list will expand
[*]TournamentMode and ExhibitionMode launch options added: When the game is launched with one of these options enabled, the exit button and other features are removed in order to make it easier to showcase the game
[*]Added resume promt: Now all players have to be ready before the game can be resumed
[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Character duck and slide height balances
[*]Animation lag reduction
[*]Rubberforest upper left corner collider has now a more useful angle
[*]Added ability to dash upwards when character stands on the ground
[*]Small Bintain02 Level improvements
[*]Small Replay improvements
[*]SFX improvements
[*]Frame rate is now caped to 400 FPS
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug where on some machines the replay was black
[/list]
